problem.title: Merge K Sorted Doubly Linked Lists
problem.problemStatement: You are given the heads of k sorted doubly linked lists. Merge all the lists into a single sorted doubly linked list while maintaining both next and prev pointers correctly. Return the head of the merged list.
problem.input: Integer k For each list: o Integer size o Sorted doubly linked list
problem.output: The merged sorted doubly linked list.
problem.constraints: 0 <= k <= 10^4 Total number of nodes across all lists does not exceed 10^5
